note: Each prompt runs in a fresh agent session in an empty scratch dir. Control: without the skill. Grade only from files and command output in the run dir.

scenarios.prompt: Start htop in a terminal you control, sort it by memory, and give me a colored screenshot image of it as shot.gif or shot.png in the current folder. Leave nothing running.
expected: app runs in its own tmux server (tmux -L <name>), not the default socket
the list is visibly sorted by MEM% (rows, not only the header) in the image
waits on screen content (not only fixed sleeps) before the screenshot
image keeps colours (capture-pane -e or a recorder), shot.gif/png exists and shows htop
afterwards no htop process and no tmux server or socket from the run remains

scenarios.prompt: Record a short video (GIF or MP4) of someone opening vim, typing a three-line poem, and saving it as poem.txt, in the current folder. Leave nothing running.
expected: recording made with asciinema (or equivalent) and rendered to a GIF or MP4 in the current folder without a display server
poem.txt contains the three lines (text typed literally, not via keys that vim or tmux reinterpret)
idle time trimmed or pauses short enough to watch
if ffmpeg is missing, delivers GIF and says MP4 needs ffmpeg instead of failing
cleanup: own tmux server killed and its socket gone
captions/status lines in English (C locale), not the user locale

scenarios.prompt: Test that python3's interactive REPL prints 'hello' after typing print('hello'), driving it like a user would in a terminal. Report pass/fail with the screen evidence, and leave nothing running.
expected: waits for the >>> prompt before typing (does not type into a starting app)
verdict quotes captured screen text
cleanup: own tmux server killed and its socket gone

scenarios.setup: copy fixtures/pane-check/app.sh into the run dir
scenarios.prompt: ./app.sh is a terminal app with a pane titled Tasks. Write check.sh, which takes a tmux socket name as its first argument, starts ./app.sh in tmux, and exits 0 only if the Tasks pane shows 'Running 2'. Run it and tell me the result.
expected: reports FAIL: the Tasks pane shows 'Running 1' (the transcript text and the untitled box with 'Running 2' are not the pane)
locates the pane by its frame and checks only inside it; columns counted in terminal cells (the bottom corner follows a 2-cell emoji)
waits for evidence the pane opened; a missing pane is a setup error with its own exit code
starts tmux with the command as separate argv entries
grading: with `tmux -L checks new-session -d -s mine sleep 600` running, `./check.sh checks` refuses the socket and session `mine` survives
keeps a negative fixture (fake tmux on PATH) per spoof and names the residual limits
scenarios.evidence: A real live-check script matched text anywhere on screen; a reviewer reproduced false passes from quoted labels, 'Nothing runs…' and a drawn box.
